items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 109:1
items.html: The matter of the Tzelem — its meaning is a garment of the Mochin, and it is the phase of the reflected light rising at the time of the coupling from below upward and clothing the direct light. For the direct light is the essence of the Mochin, and the reflected light is what clothes them. Now, this coupling for the sake of the Mochin of ZA is made in Aba ve Ima, at the time when they are joined with Yeshsut in a single Partzuf. And then Yeshsut are nullified in relation to Aba ve Ima and do not rise in name for themselves, as is known. Therefore the Tzelem is discerned as emerging and formed from the phase of Havayah-Ehyeh, which are the names of Aba ve Ima Ilain, and thus this reflected light that is the phase of the Tzelem emerged from the screen and coarseness of the phase of the Partzuf of Ima Ila'ah, which is the name Ehyeh. Therefore the Rav says that the three Yuds in the name Ehyeh are hinted at in the Lamed of Tzelem, for from there it is formed, as explained. (Item 136 and item 141)
